name: Trane Technologies
description: Trane Technologies makes and services heating, cooling and ventilation systems for buildings, homes and trucks, under two brands: Trane (commercial and residential HVAC, controls and energy services) and Thermo King (refrigeration for trucks, trailers and containers). It reports by region rather than by product: Americas (80.5 percent of 2025 revenue), EMEA and Asia Pacific. About a third of revenue is services (maintenance, parts, contracts), which recur on an installed base, and the rest is equipment sold through dealers, distributors and direct to building owners. In H1 2026 it bought the rest of LiquidStack, which makes liquid cooling for data centres.

sub.name: Heating, cooling, elevators, lighting and building controls

employees.note: Approximately 44,000 people in 62 countries, over 16,000 outside the United States.

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Sells commercial HVAC (chillers, air handlers, rooftop and unitary systems, controls) and residential heating and cooling equipment through dealers and distributors, plus Thermo King truck and trailer refrigeration; one-time equipment sales (products $13,982M in 2025) and recurring service, parts and contracting (services $7,340M, 34 percent of company revenue) on a large installed base; backlog of firm equipment and installation orders was $7,769M at 2025-12-31. Americas covers North America and Latin America; also residential HVAC and home automation.

businessLines.name: EMEA
businessLines.how: Commercial HVAC, energy services and building controls plus Thermo King transport refrigeration in Europe, the Middle East and Africa; equipment plus service revenue.

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Commercial HVAC systems, services and Thermo King transport refrigeration in Asia Pacific; equipment plus service revenue.

brands.name: Trane (HVAC)
brands.note: Commercial and residential heating, cooling, ventilation, controls, energy services; revenue split from Thermo King not read

brands.name: Thermo King
brands.note: Transport refrigeration for trucks, trailers and containers; revenue split not read

brands.name: LiquidStack
brands.note: Data-centre liquid cooling; Trane acquired all remaining interest in H1 2026 (previously a minority holding), reported in the Americas segment. Price and revenue not read.

brands.name: Kieback&Peter (49 percent)
brands.note: Building automation hardware, software and solutions; 49 percent interest acquired after 2025-12-31, equity method in EMEA.

whatsNext.text: Acquired two transport-refrigeration distributors (sales and service) and a 49 percent stake in Kieback&Peter after year end; acquired the remaining LiquidStack interest in H1 2026
